speaker: john_florio
text: Master Shakespeare? Florio. Resolute John Florio, from my lord's house in Holborn.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Master Florio. Five weeks is a long quiet to break at eleven.

speaker: john_florio
text: The paper you left at the lodge. My lord had it. He was at court for the Shrovetide running, and he has it by him still.

speaker: john_florio
text: He bids me say he is glad you prosper. I say it as he said it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I hear it as you say it. I am not asking for the rest.

speaker: john_florio
text: Nothing more is offered. A man who adds to that sentence is writing his own patron, and I am not that man.

speaker: john_florio
text: Peregrinate. Perambulate. Walk. Three words for the one plain thing, and the last is the one a player will choose.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will walk, then. The other two can live in your book.

speaker: john_florio
text: Chi va piano va sano. Who goes softly goes safely, and you go at a gallop, they tell me: a comedy, and the Inns of Court by the ears.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One proverb, and I think it is wrong.

speaker: john_florio
text: Venetia, Venetia, chi non ti vede non ti pretia. It is not wrong. It is only English.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then it may stay as it was played. I am not copying it out this afternoon.

speaker: john_florio
text: Send it to me before you send it to a printer. God keep you.
